name: Medicine Ball (Rubber, ~6 kg look)
summary: Two-tone charcoal and teal textured rubber medicine ball with a small fill valve.
description: Two-tone charcoal and teal textured rubber medicine ball with a small fill valve.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Editable UV sphere with broad teal equatorial band and charcoal poles. A 1024×512 tangent-space normal map sampled from a deterministic periodic height field supplies fine moulded grip texture. Small flattened black rubber fill valve at the front. Maps are original analytical bakes, not external images.

display.origin: Floor contact point under the ball centre.

accuracy_notes: Diameter and two-tone treatment are generic. Grip grain is a normal map and does not alter the silhouette; the periodic moulded texture compresses near UV poles. The fill valve is a shallow geometric insert, without an internal passage. No mass, bounce, deformation or fill contents are simulated.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry, materials and analytical texture bakes; no external models, fonts, images or logos.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
